transcript: Speaker A: First, I am going to the market. I need some vegetables. Next, I am looking for fresh fish. However, tomatoes look very expensive. So, I am buying one kilo of potatoes instead. Next, I need some onions. Speaker B: Best language learning app. Download now.
on_screen_text: 30 Seconds a Day to Better English. First, I am going to the market. I need some vegetables. Next, I am looking for fresh fish. However, tomatoes look very expensive. So, I am buying one kilo of potatoes instead. Next, I need some onions. DOWNLOAD NOW! START PRACTICING. Lingo AI. 4.8 out of 5 stars. Download now App Store.
summary: An AI-animated character narrates a simple market trip in English to demonstrate daily vocabulary practice. The ad promotes Lingo AI as an effective language learning tool. It concludes with a call to download the app on the App Store.
